set.body:
Outcome

Replace RoiAnalysis and RoiPayload with extension-safe estimands.

Acceptance

- Each estimand declares compatible evidence, design requirements, output type, and scientific identity.
- Adding a test estimand requires no central enum, registry, universal Response, or payload edit.
- Illegal source, target, design, or capability combinations fail before numerical execution.
- Public signatures remain readable to domain users.
set.title: P2.2: define open estimands with associated typed outputs and errors
